body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Vutec presented its frame created for Plasma and LCD TVs ‘DecoFrame’ during CES 2008.

It decoratively transforms a flat panel Plasma TV monitor or LCD into a stylish room accessory. The DecoFrame is available in nine standard sizes and ten frame finishes for Plasma and LCD's from 32- to 60-inch.
Other features include fast and easy installation, padding for bezel protection, adjustability to fit most bezels, safety mounting and built-in IR repeater.
